ideas.title: A whole day in one picture
ideas.critique: Same source as Paths we wore (logged positions drawn onto the island), but a long-exposure light-trail portrait of a day is a new way of seeing. It is still a single traced still, so it reaches the viewer like earlier stills; strong visually, little changes in the game.

ideas.title: Smoke that really flows
ideas.critique: A real fluid sim stirred by friends is physics, which goal 3 names, so predictable in area. Chimney smoke is a prop-level addition to the island unless the flow is dramatic; the shown result is likely a still or short film of a plume.

ideas.title: Seeds on the wind
ideas.critique: A slow persistent change of the ground over days, the same shape as Paths we wore, with flowers in place of worn earth. The changing flower map is a real system, but it reads as more of the island's existing flora.

ideas.title: A palm that grows on our weather
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: One more plant placed on the island, which is capped at 4. Tying it to a real growth model and the island weather is a nice twist, but a viewer sees a tree growing slowly.

ideas.title: A crystal grows
same_form: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.critique: A new permanent object appearing in the meadow, the island's most common form. Rainbow caustics and refraction suit a path tracer and goal 7, and the growth is a visible process, but friends sitting in the light is expected.

ideas.title: The island drifts
ideas.critique: It changes what the island is: its place and horizon move, and the whole crowd reacts. Nothing like it exists in the posts, and the form is new. It is hard to film and to build safely, since the sea, sky and workshop isle must all move.

ideas.title: Whistled conversations
ideas.critique: Close to the island's existing sound layers: notes on actions, and a chord that makes friends dance. Tunes that spread and mutate between friends are a genuine evolving system, but the browser audio can't be verified in the jail and a film shows it only weakly.

ideas.title: My own small rain cloud
ideas.critique: Weather that follows Lumi's mood is the same shape as the mood-driven camera, and showers, hail and clouds already exist. A small cloud over one character is another event on the island, with a rainbow payoff you can predict.

ideas.title: Tides
ideas.critique: A recurring world cycle that changes the shore and opens places is a real rule change, and goal 6 and 3 area work is not predictable by itself. The rock pools and the race with the water are standard payoffs, and it touches the beach, terrain, pier and sea plots.

ideas.title: Shell's language
ideas.critique: Shell's per-friend trust arc already exists, and a shared dictionary built from meetings has the same shape. An emergent language is interesting, but on screen it is a slate with words and creatures shouting, close to the earlier gatherings and judged-by-tool gags.
